fields.name: Year
fields.description: {"value":"The academic year when data elements contained in this file are effective.\n","fieldValueType":""}

fields.name: FedID
fields.description: {"value":"The 12 digit code derived from the US Department of Education's Common Core of Data (CCD) and used by federal agencies to uniquely identify all public schools nationwide.  The first 2 digits identify the state, the next 5 digits identify the school district and the final 5 digits identify the school.\n","fieldValueType":""}

fields.name: CDSCode
fields.description: {"value":"The 14 digit code developed and maintained by the California Department of Education that serves to uniquely identify each school and district in the state.  The first two digits identify the county, the next five digits identify the school district and the last seven digits identify the school.  School districts will have a CDS code ending in '0000000', indicating the feature is a district and not a school.","fieldValueType":""}

fields.name: CDCode
fields.description: {"value":"The 7 digit code developed and maintained by the California Department of Education that serves to uniquely identify each school district in the state.  The first two digits identify the county and the next five digits identify the school district.","fieldValueType":""}

fields.name: SCode
fields.description: {"value":"The 7 digit code developed and maintained by the California Department of Education that serves to uniquely identify each school in the state. ","fieldValueType":"uniqueIdentifier"}

fields.name: Region
fields.description: {"value":"California County Superintendents service regions.   Through a system of 11 service regions, the California County Superintendents provides the organizational mechanism for the 58 County Superintendents of Schools to design and implement statewide programs to identify and promote quality cost-effective educational practices and services, and provide support to school districts.","fieldValueType":"locationOrPlaceName"}

fields.name: CountyName
fields.description: {"value":"The name of the county associated with the public school district that operates the school.  This is usually, but not always, the same as the county where the school is physically located.","fieldValueType":"locationOrPlaceName"}

fields.name: DistrictName
fields.description: {"value":"The name of the school district that operates the school.","fieldValueType":""}

fields.name: SchoolName
fields.description: {"value":"The name of the school.","fieldValueType":"nameOrTitle"}

fields.name: SchoolType
fields.description: {"value":"A description of the school type assigned to each school that distinguishes schools based on the specific populations they serve.  The field values are generalized from the \"SchoolType\" field in the California Department of Education (CDE) school directory.  ","fieldValueType":"typeOrCategory"}

fields.name: Status
fields.description: {"value":"The operational status of the school that identifies whether the school is active, closed or pending.  ","fieldValueType":"binary"}

fields.name: OpenDate
fields.description: {"value":"The date the school opened.","fieldValueType":"dateAndTime"}

fields.name: ClosedDate
fields.description: {"value":"The date the school closed.","fieldValueType":"dateAndTime"}

fields.name: SchoolLevel
fields.description: {"value":"The level of instruction based on grades offered at the school.  These values represent a modified version of those found in the California School Directory and do  not include preschool or adult levels.","fieldValueType":"typeOrCategory"}

fields.name: GradeLow
fields.description: {"value":"The lowest grade offered or supported by the school.","fieldValueType":""}

fields.name: GradeHigh
fields.description: {"value":"The highest grade offered or supported by the school.","fieldValueType":""}

fields.name: Charter
CharterNum
fields.description: {"value":"The 4 digit number assigned to a charter school.  A blank value indicates the school is not a charter school.","fieldValueType":""}

fields.name: FundingType
fields.description:
{"value":"A description of a charter school's source of funding.
Locally funded =  Charter school receives their funding through their authorizing district or county office.
Directly funded = Charter school receives funding directly from the state.
Blank = School is not a charter school


","fieldValueType":"typeOrCategory"}

fields.name: Virtual
Magnet
TitleIStatus
DASS
fields.description: {"value":"A flag that identifies whether a school participates in the Dashboard Alternative School Status (DASS) program.  Y = School participates in the DASS program; N = School does not participate in the DASS program\n\n","fieldValueType":"binary"}

fields.name: AssistStatusESSA
fields.description:
{"value":"The assistance status category used to determine a school's eligibility for support and improvement. ATSI = Additional Targeted Support and Improvement category; CSI Low Perform =  Comprehensive Support and Improvement category based on the criteria for lowest performing school; General Assistance = School is eligible to receive general assistance.


","fieldValueType":"typeOrCategory"}

fields.name: Street
fields.description: {"value":"The physical address of the school.  This address is used as the address input field for geocoding the school record and assigning X,Y coordinates.","fieldValueType":"locationOrPlaceName"}

fields.name: City

fields.name: Zip

fields.name: State

fields.name: Locale
fields.description: {"value":"A general geographic indicator developed by the National Center for Education Statistics (NCES) to classify the type of area where a school is located.  Locale codes are based on a twelve-category framework that includes four primary classifications (city, suburban, town, and rural) that each have three sub-types.   Detailed descriptions of each category can be found at https://nces.ed.gov/programs/edge/Geographic/LocaleBoundaries","fieldValueType":""}

fields.name: Website

fields.name: SenateCAGeo
fields.description: {"value":"The California senate district assigned to the school based on the location of the school site and the intersecting senate district territory.  The 40 state senate districts are the geographically defined territories used for electing members to the upper chamber of the California State Legislature.  The current boundaries were determined by the California Citizens Redistricting Commission following the completion of the 2020 U.S Census count and will remain valid until 2030.","fieldValueType":"locationOrPlaceName"}

fields.name: AssemblyCAGeo
fields.description: {"value":"The California assembly district assigned to the school based on the location of the school site and the intersecting legislative district territory.  The 80 California state assembly districts represent the geographically defined territories used for electing members to the lower chamber of the California State Legislature.  The current boundaries were determined by the California Citizens Redistricting Commission following the 2020 United States Census and will remain valid until 2030.","fieldValueType":"locationOrPlaceName"}
